mathematical_content: For 0 < T and B - A <= T, every n in Icc A B intersect a positive dyadic shell lies in window k=0 or k=1. The second window handles the closed right endpoint n=B=A+T.
Every positive point in Icc A B has shell j=Nat.log 2 n in range (Nat.log 2 B+1) and k in range 8.
largeSource restricts to actual positive original source points above R. activeShells requires an actual largeSource point in the shell.
For every nonnegative F, the sum over largeSource is at most the sum over all eight windows in active shells.
Each window has exact cardinality H=min(T,2^j). Each shell pays at most 8*T; all active shells pay at most 8*T*(Nat.log 2 B+1).
Every start satisfies shellBase<=X and H<=X; legal j,k satisfy X<=8*B. A source witness R<=n<2*shellBase and R/16<=T gives R/16<=H.
